explanation: Fires only at the GO step and only early in the episode (about trials 1-9): it is high (8-10) when the previous trial went unrewarded, and usually low (0-1) right after a reward, though now and then it stays at 5-9 after a reward. It is 0 at D1 and D2, 0 on trial 0, and 0 at almost every GO after about trial 10, with only rare small values of 1-4 (a single 9 was seen at trial 9 after an unrewarded trial).
